name: Lisabelle no Ma 3 - Merdino Hen ~Kuroki Wazawai no Yogen~
original_name: リズベルルの魔3　メルディーノ篇～黒き災いの予言～
source:
"......A catastrophe will come. A dark, terrible disaster....."

Lisabelle and Nemuri took leave to the lake town of Merdino. The objective of their travel was to find and recruit a new party member. Promptly they met a young girl named Prancine but, in Merdino's night fog a prophet made an ominous prognostication......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE142231.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“……一场灾难即将来临。一场黑暗、可怕的灾难……”

莉莎贝尔和内穆里前往湖边小镇梅尔迪诺告别。他们此行的目的是寻找并招募一名新党员。不久，他们遇到了一位名叫普兰辛的年轻女孩，但在梅尔迪诺的夜雾中，一位先知做出了不祥的预言……
